Hear accelerator response

This listening case feeds synthetic drive states into the production audio module: idle, acceleration, full-speed gas, lift at unchanged speed, gas again, reverse braking, and nitro. Listen for the engine load changing directly on release and press. It is not a driving or frame-rate test.
